lines.text: The LORD will create new heavens and a new earth, and the former things will not be remembered.
The LORD will rejoice in Jerusalem, and the sounds of weeping and crying will no longer be heard there.
The youth will die at forty years, and anyone who fails to reach that age will be considered accursed.
His people will build houses and plant olive groves, and they will be a people blessed by the LORD.
The LORD will answer before they call, and the wolf and the lamb will feed together.
